stories.content:
[Chapter 1: The Dual Dungeon]

Deep beneath the city streets, an unranked gate opened into a pitch black cavern. Mr. Song warned everyone to keep their eyes sharp, as an uneasy stillness filled the damp air.

Jin slowly stepped toward the colossal stone doors adorned with glowing ancient glyphs. "A double dungeon inside a D-Rank gate? This cannot be real," he whispered under his breath.

Without warning, the massive stone statue seated on the central throne turned its crimson glowing eyes upon the trembling hunters. The air compressed violently as a System notification flashed in dark red: "Prepare to bow before the Lord."
